# {maize} package

# maize

{maize} 🌽 is an extension library for kernels & support vector machines
adding onto the tidymodels ecosystem. Many of the kernels are ported
from {kernlab}, additional kernels have been added directly to maize
transposed from
[Python](https://github.com/gmum/pykernels/blob/master/pykernels/regular.py)
and
[Julia](https://juliagaussianprocesses.github.io/KernelFunctions.jl/stable/kernels/)
packages.

The {parsnip} package offers three SVM kernel options: linear, radial
basis function, and polynomial. Building on this, {maize} introduces
additional kernels and supports a wider range of SVM engines. Beyond
kernel & SVM expansion to {parsnip}, {maize} also adds SVM capabilities
across other tidymodels libraries. These additions include extra
pre-processing steps for {recipes}, one-class novelty detection for
{applicable}, calibration and conformal inference tools for {probably},
and a {corrr}-like interface for kernel canonical correlation analysis.

## Installation

You can install the development version of maize from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("frankiethull/maize")
```

## engines

#### {kernlab}

SVMs with Specialty Kernels. Contains additional regression and
classification techniques such as LS-SVMs.

| {kernlab} bindings🌽 |  |  |  |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| extension | maize | engine | mode |
| {parsnip} | svm_laplace | kernlab::ksvm | regression & classification |
| {parsnip} | svm_tanh | kernlab::ksvm | regression & classification |
| {parsnip} | svm_bessel | kernlab::ksvm | regression & classification |
| {parsnip} | svm_anova_rbf | kernlab::ksvm | regression & classification |
| {parsnip} | svm_spline | kernlab::ksvm | regression & classification |
| {parsnip} | svm_cossim | kernlab::ksvm | regression & classification |
| {parsnip} | svm_cauchy | kernlab::ksvm | regression & classification |
| {parsnip} | svm_tanimoto | kernlab::ksvm | regression & classification |
| {parsnip} | svm_sorenson | kernlab::ksvm | regression & classification |
| {parsnip} | svm_tstudent | kernlab::ksvm | regression & classification |
| {parsnip} | svm_fourier | kernlab::ksvm | regression & classification |
| {parsnip} | svm_wavelet | kernlab::ksvm | regression & classification |
| {parsnip} | svm_string | kernlab::ksvm | classification |
| {parsnip} | lssvm_laplace | kernlab::lssvm | classification |
| {parsnip} | rvm_laplace | kernlab::rvm | regression |
| {parsnip} | kqr_laplace | kernlab::kqr | regression |

#### {mildsvm}

Multi-Instance Learners with SVMs. In particular, MIL with ordinal
outcomes using One-vs-All.

| {mildsvm} bindings🌽 |                 |                      |                |
|:---------------------|:----------------|:---------------------|:---------------|
| extension            | maize           | engine               | mode           |
| {parsnip}            | misvm_orova_rbf | mildsvm::misvm_orova | classification |

#### {ebmc}

Bagging and Boosting weak learners via Random Under Sampling for binary
classification.

| {ebmc} bindings🌽 |                       |             |                       |
|:------------------|:----------------------|:------------|:----------------------|
| extension         | maize                 | engine      | mode                  |
| {parsnip}         | bag_svm_laplace       | ebmc::ub    | binary-classification |
| {parsnip}         | rus_boost_svm_laplace | ebmc::rus   | binary-classification |
| {parsnip}         | ada_boost_svm_laplace | ebmc::adam2 | binary-classification |

### recipes

Steps for feature engineering data via kernel related methods.

| pre-processors🌽 |  |  |  |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| extension | maize | engine | mode |
| {recipes} | step_kpca_laplace | kernlab::kpca | transformation steps |
| {recipes} | step_kpca_tanh | kernlab::kpca | transformation steps |
| {recipes} | step_kha_laplace | kernlab::kha | transformation steps |
| {recipes} | step_kha_tanh | kernlab::kha | transformation steps |
| {recipes} | step_kfa_laplace | kernlab::kfa | transformation steps |
| {recipes} | step_kfm_nystrom | mildsvm::kfm_nystrom | transformation steps |

### probably

Point calibration and conformal quantile regression with SVMs (QRSVM)
for prediction intervals.

| post-processors🌽 |  |  |  |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| extension | maize | engine | mode |
| {probably} | int_conformal_quantile_svm | qrsvm::qrsvm | prediction intervals |
| {probably} | cal_estimate_svm | kernlab::ksvm | calibrator |

### modeltime

A special implementation of SVMs for time series regression. ARIMA &
AutoARIMA with SVM Errors are registered in maize. The *harvestime*
vignette showcases how-to-use ARIMA-SVMs & Recursive SVMs.

| {modeltime} bindings🌽 |  |  |  |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| extension | maize | engine | mode |
| {modeltime} | arima_svm_laplace | forecast::Arima + maize::svm_laplace | regression |

### applicable

One-Class SVMs for novelty detection

| applicability🌽 |  |  |  |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| extension | maize | engine | mode |
| {applicable} | apd_svm_novel_detection | kernlab::ksvm | one-SVC novelty detection |

### corrr

Inspired by corrr, returns a tidy data frame class (kcor_df) for Kernel
Canonical Correlation Analysis:

| KCCA🌽 |  |  |  |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| extension | maize | engine | mode |
| {corrr} | kcca_correlate | kernlab::kcca | kernel canonical correlation analysis |

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ada_boost_svm_rbf()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/ada_boost_svm_rbf.md)
  : AdaBoost SVM with Radial Basis Function Kernel

- [`apd_svm_novel_detection()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/apd_svm_novel_detection.md)
  : Fit an SVM novelty detection model to estimate an applicability
  domain.

- [`arima_svm_laplace()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/arima_svm_laplace.md)
  : General Interface for "Support Vector Machine" ARIMA Regression
  Models

- [`autoplot(`*`<kcor_df>`*`)`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/autoplot.kcor_df.md)
  : visualize component x-y feature space

- [`bag_svm_rbf()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/bag_svm_rbf.md)
  : RUS Bagged SVM with Radial Basis Function Kernel

- [`cal_estimate_svm()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/cal_estimate_svm.md)
  : Uses a support vector regression model to calibrate numeric
  predictions

- [`corn_data`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/corn_data.md)
  : Synthetic Corn Dataset for Corny Example

- [`int_conformal_quantile_svm()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/int_conformal_quantile_svm.md)
  : Prediction intervals via conformal inference and QRSVM

- [`kcca_correlate()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/kcca_correlate.md)
  : Kernel Canonical Correlation Analysis

- [`kqr_laplace()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/kqr_laplace.md)
  : Laplacian Kernel Quantile Regression

- [`lssvm_laplace()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/lssvm_laplace.md)
  : Laplacian Least Squares Support Vector Machine

- [`misvm_orova_rbf()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/misvm_orova_rbf.md)
  : Multiple Instance SVMs for Ordinal Outcome Data, One-Vs-All, with
  Radial Basis Function Kernel

- [`rus_boost_svm_rbf()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/rus_boost_svm_rbf.md)
  : RUSBoost SVM with Radial Basis Function Kernel

- [`rvm_laplace()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/rvm_laplace.md)
  : Laplacian Relevance Vector Machine (Experimental RVM)

- [`score(`*`<apd_svm_novel_detection>`*`)`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/score.apd_svm_novel_detection.md)
  :

  Predict from a `apd_svm_novel_detection`

- [`step_kfa_laplace()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/step_kfa_laplace.md)
  : Laplacian function kernel KFA signal extraction

- [`step_kfm_nystrom()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/step_kfm_nystrom.md)
  : Nystrom kernel feature map approximation (RBF)

- [`step_kha_laplace()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/step_kha_laplace.md)
  : Laplacian function kernel PCA signal extraction via Hebbian
  Algorithm

- [`step_kha_tanh()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/step_kha_tanh.md)
  : tanh function kernel PCA signal extraction via Hebbian Algorithm

- [`step_kpca_laplace()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/step_kpca_laplace.md)
  : Laplacian function kernel PCA signal extraction

- [`step_kpca_tanh()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/step_kpca_tanh.md)
  : Laplacian function kernel PCA signal extraction

- [`svm_anova_rbf()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/svm_anova_rbf.md)
  : ANOVA RBF Support Vector Machine

- [`svm_bessel()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/svm_bessel.md)
  : Bessel Support Vector Machine

- [`svm_cauchy()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/svm_cauchy.md)
  : Cauchy Support Vector Machine

- [`svm_cossim()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/svm_cossim.md)
  : Cosine Similarity Support Vector Machine

- [`svm_fourier()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/svm_fourier.md)
  : Fourier Support Vector Machine

- [`svm_laplace()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/svm_laplace.md)
  : Laplacian Support Vector Machine

- [`svm_sorensen()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/svm_sorensen.md)
  : Sorensen Support Vector Machine

- [`svm_spline()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/svm_spline.md)
  : Spline Support Vector Machine

- [`svm_string()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/svm_string.md)
  : String Support Vector Machine

- [`svm_tanh()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/svm_tanh.md)
  : Hyperbolic Tangent Support Vector Machine

- [`svm_tanimoto()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/svm_tanimoto.md)
  : Tanimoto Support Vector Machine

- [`svm_tstudent()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/svm_tstudent.md)
  : T-Student Support Vector Machine

- [`svm_wavelet()`](https://frankiethull.github.io/maize/reference/svm_wavelet.md)
  : Wavelet Support Vector Machine
